purpose: Prevent a trusted chart/print-only +100% crossing from becoming the factory's primary success label unless the frozen position is realistically executable at a predeclared notional under timestamp-safe PIT microstructure evidence.

normative_relationship.parent_hit_semantics: The parent HIT state is a descriptive PRICE_2X_CROSSING path fact only. It has zero primary tradable-success, precision@K, lift, PR-AUC, calibration or model-fitting authority by itself.

frozen_tradability_anchor.required_exact_file_digest_binding: The trusted contract-registry receipt must bind the exact SHA-256 of the deployed precommitment bytes in addition to artifact_id/schema. Repository path or artifact_id alone is insufficient.

ex_ante_execution_policy.chronology: The execution policy must be frozen at or before trusted server formation time for prospective confirmatory use and before any governed post-formation outcome/microstructure evidence is consumed.
ex_ante_execution_policy.band_rule: Evaluated bands must be a frozen subset of [1000,10000,50000,100000]. A single primary tradable-success metric/ranker requires primary_success_band_usd to be frozen before outcomes. If primary_success_band_usd is NONE, only per-band research labels may be reported; the system may not select the best-looking band after outcome.
ex_ante_execution_policy.venue_rule: The exact execution venue/instrument or deterministic multi-venue aggregation policy must be frozen before outcome. A later thin-venue target print cannot be paired with post-hoc liquidity from another venue, and a favorable venue may not be substituted after the move.
ex_ante_execution_policy.threshold_rule: Do not tune spread, depth, VWAP slippage, staleness, persistence or venue thresholds after observing the path. Reuse the frozen 2X-TRADABILITY-001-v1 limits unless a separately versioned successor was itself trusted and frozen before the governed formation.

entry_tradability.rule: Before a formation can ever become TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND, its frozen band must satisfy the existing 2X-TRADABILITY-001-v1 predecision STRICT_TRADABLE entry rule using timestamp-safe spread plus executable ask-side depth/VWAP evidence. ADV/quote volume is descriptive only and cannot substitute for depth.

crossing_side_execution.event_definition: TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND occurs only when, after formation and on/before expiry, provider-authenticated bid-side executable depth for the frozen band proves a target-or-better liquidation opportunity on the frozen execution venue/policy. PRICE_2X_CROSSING may occur earlier and remains separately retained.
crossing_side_execution.position_quantity_semantics: For band B and trusted frozen reference price R, test the reference-quantity Q=B/R. The executable bid-side VWAP for selling Q under the frozen venue policy must be at or above the frozen target price. This defines a target-executable price move; it does not claim fee-adjusted net portfolio return.
required_evidence: provider-authenticated best bid and best ask or equivalent spread proof
provider-authenticated bid depth ladder or deterministic provider-native executable quote sufficient to sell the full frozen reference-quantity
exact canonical asset plus frozen venue/instrument identity
provider event/snapshot timestamp and capture/availability chronology
raw/provider-native evidence digest plus trusted durable membership
gap/staleness state under the frozen policy
deterministic bid-side VWAP and slippage derivation
crossing_side_execution.timing: The tradable-hit event time is the earliest authenticated microstructure observation/interval proving the full frozen-band target execution opportunity. Exact timestamps require authenticated point/event timing; aggregate evidence remains interval-censored under the parent contract.
crossing_side_execution.flash_wick_rule: A one-lot/isolated target trade or interval high with no qualifying bid-side executable depth does not establish TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND.
crossing_side_execution.unknown_rule: If required crossing-side spread/depth/slippage evidence is unavailable, stale, gapped, identity-mismatched, or not source-authenticated, preserve PRICE_2X_CROSSING and emit PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN for tradable-success evaluation.
crossing_side_execution.illiquid_rule: If authenticated evidence affirmatively shows the frozen band cannot satisfy the frozen spread/depth/VWAP rule, preserve PRICE_2X_CROSSING but classify the tradability result as ILLIQUID_2X_RESEARCH_ONLY rather than an ordinary positive.

cross_venue_fragmentation.rule: Price and execution evidence must obey the same ex-ante venue policy. A target reached only on an excluded thin/off-venue market cannot establish a tradable hit. Cross-venue liquidity may count only when a deterministic aggregation policy and exact venue set were frozen before outcome and every contributing record is identity/provenance bound.
cross_venue_fragmentation.unknown_rule: Fragmented or conflicting venue evidence that the frozen policy cannot deterministically reconcile remains PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN, never a post-hoc venue-selection opportunity.

PRICE_2X_CROSSING.model_role: Descriptive/research event retained regardless of strict tradability.

TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND.meaning: PRICE_2X_CROSSING plus strict predecision entry tradability and an authenticated target-or-better bid-side execution opportunity for the same frozen band/venue policy within horizon.
TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND.primary_metrics_role: Eligible primary positive only after every parent/chronology/closure/contract-registry gate independently verifies.

PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN.meaning: Price target crossed but required strict microstructure evidence is missing, stale, gapped, identity-invalid or otherwise not authoritative.
PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN.model_role: Research-only/censored for tradable-success metrics; never imputed positive from ADV, quote volume or current liquidity.

ILLIQUID_2X_RESEARCH_ONLY.meaning: Price target crossed while authenticated evidence shows the frozen band fails the frozen execution rule.
ILLIQUID_2X_RESEARCH_ONLY.model_role: Preserved negative/competing liquidity outcome for tradable-success research, not deleted by survivor/liquidity filtering.

competing_event_integration.rule: TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND, not raw PRICE_2X_CROSSING, is the primary 2x success event for tradable factory metrics. Its event time competes with structured invalidation, illiquidity/delisting and predeclared drawdown under the parent's ordering rules. If event-order intervals overlap and trusted chronology cannot identify precedence, retain CENSORED_COMPETING_EVENT_ORDER.
competing_event_integration.price_crossing_before_failure: A raw target print before a later tradable execution opportunity does not lock in success. If a mutually exclusive competing event occurs first, the tradable hit did not occur first merely because PRICE_2X_CROSSING did.

closure_revision_and_supersession.rule: Authoritative microstructure members used for tradability are part of the governed evidence lineage and must be included in closure/finality high-water marks and revision policy. A late authenticated depth/spread revision that changes tradability must deterministically supersede the prior current resolution or remain inadmissible only under an ex-ante immutable-source finality rule.
closure_revision_and_supersession.no_silent_filter: A superseded tradable/unknown/illiquid state may not remain in current precision, lift, PR-AUC, calibration or model-fitting metrics.

mandatory_red_green_tests: a one-lot or flash-wick target print with no executable frozen-band bid depth remains PRICE_2X_CROSSING but cannot become TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND
an interval high at or above target with missing spread/depth evidence becomes PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN for primary tradable-success metrics
a target reached only on an excluded thin off-venue market cannot use liquidity from a different venue to become a tradable hit

authenticated target-or-better bid-side depth that sells the full frozen reference-quantity within the frozen spread/slippage limits can establish TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND when every independent parent gate also verifies
ADV or quote volume alone can never upgrade PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN to a tradable hit
the same raw price path cannot change authoritative tradability because a notional band or venue is selected after outcome
changing the frozen notional, venue policy, execution-policy fingerprint or contributing microstructure member changes the final fingerprint
a late authoritative microstructure revision that changes tradability cannot leave a contradicted prior result current
cross-asset, cross-venue and cross-instrument microstructure transplantation is rejected even when raw hashes otherwise verify
a raw price crossing before invalidation/delisting/drawdown cannot outrank the competing event when the first tradable execution opportunity occurs later
overlapping tradable-hit and competing-event censoring intervals retain CENSORED_COMPETING_EVENT_ORDER unless authenticated chronology resolves precedence
metrics_rule: precision@K, lift, PR-AUC, calibration and model fitting for the primary tradable-2x objective may count only verified TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND labels at the ex-ante primary band or report separately frozen per-band metrics. PRICE_2X_CROSSING, PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN and ILLIQUID_2X_RESEARCH_ONLY are never silently pooled as equivalent positives.
